verses.text: A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to You, the One enthroned in heaven.

segments.text: A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to You, the One enthroned in heaven.

verses.text: As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maidservant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes are on the LORD our God until He shows us mercy.

segments.text: As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maidservant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes are on the LORD our God until He shows us mercy.

verses.text: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy, for we have endured much contempt.

segments.text: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy, for we have endured much contempt.

verses.text: We have endured much scorn from the arrogant, much contempt from the proud.

segments.text: We have endured much scorn from the arrogant, much contempt from the proud.
